transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… I just don’t feel like myself anymore. I used to make time for things—painting, hiking, choir, seeing family on Sundays. Lately, even if I have a free hour, I just sit there. I can’t seem to care about any of it.
Do you still enjoy the things you used to do when you actually do them, or has the pleasure gone away too?
Yeah… the pleasure’s mostly gone. Even if I try to paint or go out, it just feels flat. I used to care about those things, and now I kind of just… sit there.
Do you feel sad most of the time?
Most days, yes. It’s like… everything has this gray film over it. Even when I’m at school with the kids or at home with my husband, I still feel kind of hollow. Close to crying, sometimes.
Do you still enjoy being around your husband and other people, or has that become flat too?

It’s become pretty flat, I guess. I still love my husband and my family, but being around people doesn’t… feel like it used to. Even Sunday gatherings, choir—things I used to make time for—I just don’t really care to go now.
Have you noticed any change in your weight recently?
I… I’m not really sure. I haven’t been paying close attention to it.
Have you been having trouble sleeping lately?

Yeah… my sleep’s been pretty bad. It’s kind of all over the place. I lie there going over work things in my head, grant details and stuff, and then I’m up around three or four. Even if I stay in bed longer, I don’t really feel rested.
Do you feel like you're moving more slowly than usual or having trouble getting things done because you're feeling sluggish?
I don’t know… maybe a little, but I haven’t really paid attention to it. I’m getting things done, just… it feels harder sometimes.
Do you often feel guilty or worthless about things?

Yeah… I guess I do. When something goes wrong with the curriculum project, even a small thing, I start thinking I’m letting the students down. And… that I’m wasting what my parents did for me to get here.
Do you feel like you're moving more slowly than usual?
I’m not really sure. I mean… maybe a bit, but I haven’t noticed myself moving slowly exactly. It’s more that things take effort.
Do you feel like you're resting enough during the day or do you feel tired even after you've been sitting or resting?
I’m not sure. I do sit down sometimes, but I don’t really think about whether it helps or not. I guess I just… keep going.
Do you feel like you're moving more slowly than other people around you?
I… I don’t really know. I haven’t noticed if I’m slower than other people. I’m mostly just trying to get through what I need to do.
Do you feel like your body is heavy or hard to move?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t say heavy exactly. It’s more just hard to get myself going sometimes, but I haven’t really noticed my body feeling heavy.
Do you feel like it's harder to initiate movements or activities than it used to be?
I’m not really sure. Sometimes it takes me a bit to start doing things, but I don’t know if that’s… movement exactly, or just me not getting started.
Do you feel like it's an effort to initiate physical movements, like getting out of bed or walking?
I’m not sure… getting out of bed can feel like a lot, but I don’t know if it’s the actual moving part. Walking, I haven’t really noticed.
Do you feel like it takes you longer to do things than it used to?
Maybe a little? I don’t really keep track. Some things feel slower, but I can’t say for sure it’s taking longer than it used to.
Do you feel like it's hard to get started with daily activities?
I don’t really know. Some days I just… don’t get going very quickly, but I’m not sure if I’d call it hard exactly.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?
I don’t think so. I haven’t really been watching it closely, but nothing significant that I’ve noticed.
Do you feel like it's hard to get started with physical activities like walking or getting out of bed?
I’m not really sure. I mean, getting out of bed can be slow sometimes, but I haven’t noticed it in a clear way with walking or anything.
Do you feel like your movements have slowed down compared to how they used to be?
I haven’t really noticed that, no. Maybe I’m a bit slower some mornings, but I don’t know if my movements are actually slower.
Have you had any thoughts of death or suicide?

Yes… sometimes. Late at night, I’ll think it would be easier if I just didn’t wake up. I haven’t made a plan or anything, but it scared me enough that I told my husband I couldn’t keep dealing with it by myself.
